protocol.question: Among the poses the frozen Run 8 search already produces, can a ranking rule chosen on PoseBusters by a rule fixed here pick a sub-2.0 A pose first more often than the Run 8 rule, on complexes that neither Genesis nor GNINA has ever seen?

whatIsAlreadyKnownBeforeThisFreeze.statement: Diagnostics already computed on the Run 8 pools and pushed in docs/evidence/run9-plan/ (commit f5d12d06), recorded here so that nobody can later claim the development phase started blind.
whatIsAlreadyKnownBeforeThisFreeze.rankSumConsensusOnPoseBusters: 215 to 217 of 308 for GNINA weights 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.7, against 204 for the Run 8 rule
whatIsAlreadyKnownBeforeThisFreeze.agreement: the two scorers pick the same pose in 138 of 290 scored cases, correct in 128
whatIsAlreadyKnownBeforeThisFreeze.disagreement: 152 cases, GNINA right 76, Vina right 74, either right 108
whatIsAlreadyKnownBeforeThisFreeze.notYetComputed: the plausibility filter, the cluster-support tie-break and every combination of them; these are the phase-D measurements and are selected by the rule below, not by judgement

phaseD_development.set: PoseBusters Benchmark set, 308 cases, the Run 8 per-case pools and pose files exactly as produced by Run 8. No re-docking.
allowedChangesToThePipeline: the ranking rule, chosen only from the candidate family below by the selection rule below

an input adapter that reads the fresh set's distribution format (receptor.cif + ligand SDF per system) into the unchanged Run 8 preparation; it may be developed only on PoseBusters and on the single example system shipped in the benchmark's own GitHub repository (8c3u__1__1.A__1.C), never on fresh-set data

a fix for receptor atom types GNINA cannot parse (the cause of Run 8's three UNAVAILABLE cases 7SUC, 7UMW, 7XRL), developed on those three cases; it must leave every other Run 8 case's receptor file byte-identical, which is checked and reported
the Run 8 glue fix for cases where only some seeds dock (commit 8f7ed018), already in place
phaseD_development.everythingElseStaysTheRun8Pipeline: Vina 1.2.7, Meeko 0.8.0, RDKit and biotite as pinned for Run 8, seeds 42/1042/2042/3042/4042, exhaustiveness 32, num_modes 20, energy_range 20.0, box from the crystal ligand as in Run 8, pooling across seeds, dedup at 1.0 A, GNINA 1.3 --score_only --cnn crossdock_default2018_ensemble on the CPU.

candidateRankerFamily.C0: Run 8 rule: GNINA cnnScore descending. The comparator, never selectable.
candidateRankerFamily.C1(w): rank-sum consensus: minimise w * rank_by_cnnScore + (1 - w) * rank_by_Vina_affinity, w in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7}; ties by the pooled order
candidateRankerFamily.C2(w): C1(w) applied after a physical-plausibility filter: a pose is removed if it fails any of the PoseBusters package checks for internal geometry (bond lengths, bond angles, internal steric clash, aromatic ring flatness, double-bond flatness, internal energy) or for intermolecular clash with the protein; if every pose of a case fails, no pose is removed. The package version is pinned in seal B.
candidateRankerFamily.C3(w): C2(w), then among the two best-ranked surviving poses the one with more pooled poses within 2.0 A of it (cluster support across seeds) is taken first; ties keep the C2(w) order
candidateRankerFamily.C4: PRODUCT-ELIGIBLE ARM, no GNINA: Vina affinity after the C2 filter, then the C3 cluster-support tie-break. Evaluated and reported separately; it is not part of the selection and has its own verdict.

phaseD_development.selectionRule: Compute top-1 on all 308 PoseBusters cases (denominator 308, every failure kept) for the nine variants C1(0.3), C1(0.5), C1(0.7), C2(...), C3(...). Select the variant with the highest top-1. Ties are broken toward fewer components (C1 before C2 before C3), then toward w = 0.5. The selected variant is the Run 9 ranker R. If R does not beat C0 by at least +2.0 percentage points on PoseBusters, the outcome is NO_RANKER_SELECTED: it is reported, and phase F is not run for the primary comparison.
phaseD_development.noOtherCandidates: No variant outside this family is evaluated in phase D and kept. Adding a candidate after seeing any phase-D number requires a new preregistration and a new fresh set.

freshSet.name: Runs N' Poses
freshSet.why: a published benchmark built specifically to test generalisation beyond training data, with structural similarity of every system to the whole PDB up to 2021-09-30 precomputed by its authors; Genesis has never docked, scored or opened any of it.
freshSet.upstream: Skrinjar et al., 'Have protein-ligand co-folding methods moved beyond memorisation?', bioRxiv doi 10.1101/2025.02.03.636309; repository github.com/plinder-org/runs-n-poses at commit 197fafc60a5cef3a9e7f8a4b0dac7c965eed3839 (Apache-2.0); data Zenodo doi 10.5281/zenodo.14794785, files annotations.csv and ground_truth.tar.gz
freshSet.accessState: BLOCKED at the time of this freeze: zenodo.org is denied by this environment's network policy (probed 2026-10-03 00:15Z, together with files.rcsb.org, data.rcsb.org, files.wwpdb.org, www.ebi.ac.uk, pdbj.org and polarishub.io, all denied). Only the code repository could be cloned. Nothing from the data release has been seen.
freshSet.noSubstituteSource: If zenodo.org stays blocked, Run 9 is not run. No mirror, no other benchmark and no self-assembled set is substituted under this preregistration.
eligibility: ligand_is_proper is true and num_proper_ligand_chains equals 1
entry PDB id absent from the PoseBusters 308, the Astex 85, CrossDocked2020 ids and PDBbind2016 ids (the same GNINA lists, same commit, as the Run 8 contamination audit)
one system per PDB id: the first one in the draw order below
freshSet.draw: Order eligible systems by sha256('run9|' + group_key) ascending and take the first 300. If fewer than 300 are eligible, take all of them. The case list file and its sha256 are written into seal B before any docking.
freshSet.denominator: every drawn case. PREPARATION_FAILED, DOCKING_FAILED and UNAVAILABLE stay in the denominator as failures for every arm, reported by name, never re-docked because of a poor result, never replaced.

phaseF_final.runOnce: The frozen pipeline from seal B runs once on the fresh set. Infrastructure aborts are resumed with the identical command and logged, as in Run 8; no case is recomputed because of its result.
phaseF_final.metric: PRIMARY: top-1 success, symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD < 2.0 A without superposition (rdMolAlign.CalcRMS, as in Run 8), denominator = all drawn cases. Secondary: top-3/5, sampling ceiling, per-seed top-1 with each rule applied to each seed's own poses, and the result split into thirds of the authors' sucos_shape_pocket_qcov similarity.
phaseF_final.primaryComparison: R versus C0 on the same pooled poses, paired by case

verdict.GENERALISES: R minus C0 >= +3.0 percentage points AND one-sided exact McNemar test on the discordant cases p < 0.05 AND R minus C0 >= 0 on at least 4 of the 5 per-seed analyses
verdict.DOES_NOT_GENERALISE: R minus C0 <= +1.0 percentage point OR R minus C0 < 0 on 2 or more of the 5 per-seed analyses

phaseF_final.secondaryVerdictC4: The same three-way criterion applied to C4 versus Vina-affinity top-1 on the same pooled poses.
phaseF_final.reportedRegardlessOfOutcome: both verdicts, every failure by name, the phase-D table of all nine variants, and this prediction scored against reality

falsifiablePrediction.phaseD: the selected R reaches 214 to 222 of 308 on PoseBusters
falsifiablePrediction.phaseF_gainOverC0: +1.5 to +4.0 percentage points; development gains shrink on unseen data and the selection itself is optimistic
falsifiablePrediction.phaseF_verdictPredicted: PARTIAL, with GENERALISES possible; recorded as a weak prior only
falsifiablePrediction.caveat: my Run 8 gap prediction (+8 to +16 pp) was wrong; the result was +0.65

protocol.productBoundary: No ranker from this work enters the product before a GENERALISES verdict on the fresh set. Any ranker that uses GNINA (C1-C3, hence R) stays out of the product even then, until GNINA's GPL and model-weight licensing are resolved; C4 is the only arm that could become product-eligible.
forbidden: opening, listing or summarising fresh-set data before seal B is committed, beyond annotations.csv columns needed for the eligibility rule
changing any rule, threshold, candidate, weight, filter or denominator after a phase-D or phase-F number is seen
evaluating a ranker outside the frozen family and keeping it
running phase F more than once or reporting the better of two runs
per-case, per-target or per-PDB exceptions, repairs or boxes
removing, replacing or substituting any case
comparing the fresh-set absolute rate one-to-one with Astex or PoseBusters
any modification of Runs 1-8, their preregistrations or their evidence
protocol.computeCost: phase D: no docking, scoring of existing pools only, plus the PoseBusters checks on about 17,000 poses. Phase F: about 300 cases x 5 seeds = 1,500 Vina runs at exhaustiveness 32 plus GNINA scoring, comparable to Run 8, which took about two days of wall clock on 4 cores including three container restarts.
